item.title: Trump ignites cognitive health concerns after mixing up his father's birthplace
item.description: President Donald Trump stirred renewed concerns about his mental acuity on Tuesday when he confused his father's birthplace during a White House meeting with German Chancellor Friedrich Merz. Trump stated his father was born in Germany, when actually Fred Trump was born in the Bronx in 1905. Trump's grandfather, Frederick Trump, was born in Bavaria in 1869 and immigrated to the U.S. in 1885.
